Thanks Jane — appreciate the screenshot. A few preliminary notes from infra:

- From the symptom description it looks like the post-auth redirect to our onboarding callback is returning a 302 to the frontend, but the session cookie is being rejected by the browser on the redirect step (same-site/secure attributes or third-party cookie policy). That causes the server to treat the new request as unauthenticated and show 'Session expired'.

- We have seen similar failures when the user agent blocks cross-site cookies or when a passkey flow triggers a UA that treats the relying party as third-party (rare).

What we need from Blue Harbor for root cause:
1) HAR capture covering the steps from Login -> Passkey prompt -> Redirect back to https://zip.redwood.com/onboard/callback.
2) Exact timestamps (to match our logs).

If you can't produce a HAR immediately, a fast mitigation is:
- Use incognito window with no extensions and ensure 3rd-party cookies are allowed for zip.redwood.com OR
- Use the email-based temporary onboarding (Vanessa suggested) so procurement can proceed.

I've requested a hot ticket with Platform SRE (support.redwood.com/ticket/67890) and will attach matching server-side logs when we have the HAR.

—Rishi
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
